system.description: Heavy silver vapor that wards against the Malfeas miasma for one day. Also causes euphoria for one hour. Poison traits: Damage 2B/hour, Toxicity 4M, Tolerance (Stamina)/1 day, Penalty -2. Can be addictive to mortals. Long-term use turns hair, teeth, and nails gray and may cause physical degeneration. Costs Resources 3 per dose, Resources 5 per month.
